#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

int n, m, MOD;

inline ll modPow(ll base, int exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
    
    if (m > n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    ll ans = 0;
    
    for (int pos = 1; pos <= n; ++pos) {
        for (int left = 0; left <= pos - 1; ++left) {
            for (int right = 0; right <= n - pos; ++right) {
                if (left + right > m) continue;
                
                ll ways = 1;
                
                ways = ways * modPow(2, left + right) % MOD;
                
                ll comb = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < left; ++i) {
                    comb = comb * (pos - 1 - i) % MOD;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < right; ++i) {
                    comb = comb * (n - pos - i) % MOD;
                }
                
                ll fact = 1;
                for (int i = 1; i <= left + right; ++i) {
                    fact = fact * i % MOD;
                }
                
                ll invFact = modPow(fact, MOD - 2);
                
                ll totalWays = comb * invFact % MOD * modPow(2, m - left - right) % MOD;
                
                for (int i = 1; i <= m - left - right; ++i) {
                    totalWays = totalWays * (n - left - right) % MOD;
                }
                
                ans = (ans + totalWays * (left + right) % MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
